title: Port original static system prompt sections
objective: Replace the simplified Go base identity with a sectioned prompt that preserves the original implementation's static behavior semantics.
context: Go baseIdentity is currently much smaller than the original prompt contract.
The original static path includes intro, system reminders, task execution behavior, careful action guidance, tool-use policy, tone/style, and output efficiency.
DeepSeek branding may remain if it is an intended product fork, but the behavioral contract should match the original.
deliverables: Implement static prompt section functions corresponding to the original System, Doing tasks, Executing actions with care, Using your tools, Tone/style, and Output efficiency sections.
Replace the generic Available Tools dump with global guidance about how to use tools.
Support the original simple-mode minimal prompt shape.
Add golden-style tests for section order and enabled-tool-dependent text.
acceptance: Default static prompt output is ordered and sectioned like the original.
Tool descriptions are not duplicated in the system prompt and API tool schema.
Brand replacement is centralized and tested.
Existing prompt tests are updated rather than weakened.
non_goals: Do not implement CLAUDE.md or user context injection.
Do not implement Git/environment dynamic sections.
Do not change provider cache behavior.
handoff_notes: Preserve a small public surface so task_08 can insert cache boundary metadata around static sections later.
